Name: sereinflow_list_projects
Description: List bounded non-archived project and flow summaries.

Name: sereinflow_list_archived_projects
Description: List bounded archived project and flow summaries.

Name: sereinflow_preview_create_project
Description: Preview creating a new draft project with an empty main flow.

Name: sereinflow_apply_create_project
Description: Create a previously previewed draft project after task-level authorization.

idempotencyKey.description: A fresh key for this exact apply request.

Name: sereinflow_get_project
Description: Get one project and its flow summaries.

Name: sereinflow_get_flow_topology
Description: Read a bounded flow topology. track defaults to development and accepts development or production.

Name: sereinflow_list_libraries
Description: List bounded available library artifact summaries. Set includeArchived only for the legacy all-lifecycles view; use sereinflow_list_archived_libraries for archived artifacts.

Name: sereinflow_list_archived_libraries
Description: List bounded archived library artifact summaries.

Name: sereinflow_get_library
Description: Read one library's scanned node and parameter contracts.

Name: sereinflow_list_library_families
Description: List bounded library families and their immutable artifact versions.

Name: sereinflow_get_library_family
Description: Read one library family and its immutable artifact versions.

Name: sereinflow_get_project_libraries
Description: Read bounded library artifacts referenced by one project.

Name: sereinflow_get_library_upgrade
Description: Read one persisted project library upgrade analysis and per-flow results.

Name: sereinflow_get_run_inspection
Description: Read a bounded run snapshot, timeline, node outputs and debug state. track accepts development or production when supplied.

Name: sereinflow_get_run_variables
Description: Read live run variables or the saved final snapshot with CLR types and bounded JSON values. Supply name for one variable; otherwise use offset/take (1-200). Complex CLR objects expose metadata only. Requires run.read; older runs or forcibly terminated Workers may have no saved snapshot.

Name: sereinflow_set_run_variable
Description: Set one live run variable using an explicit built-in CLR value type. Requires run.variable.write and an idempotencyKey; does not persist across runs.

idempotencyKey.description: A fresh key for this exact variable write request.

Name: sereinflow_list_run_workpieces
Description: List image and file workpieces uploaded by nodes in one run.

Name: sereinflow_get_run_workpiece
Description: Read metadata and the API download URL for one run workpiece.

Name: sereinflow_publish_run_message
Description: Publish an arbitrary JSON value to an explicitly exposed endpoint in an active run. channelKind is optional and defaults to queue; canonical values are queue or eventBus. The result acknowledges Worker broker acceptance, not downstream business completion.

idempotencyKey.description: A fresh key for this exact message publish request.

Name: sereinflow_list_runs
Description: List bounded run summaries, optionally filtered by project and status. status accepts pending, running, succeeded, failed, cancelled, timedOut or interrupted.

Name: sereinflow_list_debug_sessions
Description: List bounded active debug session summaries.

Name: sereinflow_get_debug_state
Description: Read the structured state of one debug session.

Name: sereinflow_wait_debug_state
Description: Wait for a newer paused debug state or a terminal state. Running progress remains available through sereinflow_get_debug_state.

Name: sereinflow_start_debug_session
Description: Start a bounded debug Worker session for a saved flow.

idempotencyKey.description: A fresh key for this exact debug start request.

Name: sereinflow_continue_debug
Description: Continue a paused debug session.

Name: sereinflow_step_debug
Description: Execute one node boundary in a paused debug session.

Name: sereinflow_stop_debug
Description: Stop an active debug session.

Name: sereinflow_get_flow_edit_model
Description: Read the development flow model used to create safe structured patches.

Name: sereinflow_create_library_node_template
Description: Create a read-only Action or Flipflop node template from a library contract already attached to the project.

Name: sereinflow_create_builtin_node_template
Description: Create a complete schema 2.0 patch node from a built-in node descriptor in the flow edit model.

Name: sereinflow_preview_flow_patch
Description: Validate a structured development-flow patch and return its diff. New requests use schemaVersion 2.0, canonical camelCase enums, an op discriminator, and named payload fields. For connection payloads, kind=execution uses branch=success/failure/error and dataSource=null; kind=data uses branch=null and dataSource=previousNode. The dataSource field is required but nullable in schema 2.0. Removing the current entry node automatically clears entryNodeId when that node is absent from the final canvas, so removing the last node produces a savable empty draft. Legacy operation/value input remains read-compatible.
